name: qfd_c_stn516_safe-s0-COMMIT
purpose: qfd_c_b16_dv fabric station: one 516-b register stage (x52 per cluster)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_c_stn516 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_stn.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: stn_exact
bench.pass_regex: STN_BENCH PASS qfd_c_stn516 0 errors in 20000 cycles

bench.name: stn_mutant
bench.fail_regex: STN_BENCH FAIL qfd_c_stn516 [1-9]\d* errors in 20000 cycles

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_stn516_safe/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_stn516_safe/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_stn516_safe --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_c_stn516  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: SAFE-QW-CB16: unchanged one-edge plain station, enlarged full data faces to<=6pins/um, io_hold0.03; parent clocks reach hardchild clockpins. Unbound until geometry/native/parent replay.
